name: Bremazocine
summary: Bremazocine is a κ-opioid receptor agonist related to pentazocine. It has potent and long-lasting analgesic and diuretic effects. It has 200 times the activity of morphine, but appears to have no addictive properties and does not depress breathing. The crystal structure of bremazocine was determined in 1984

pharmacology.text: Bremazocine is a κ-opioid receptor agonist related to pentazocine.

summaryZh: 布馬佐辛是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C20H29NO2，屬噴他佐辛的結構類似物，可作為鎮痛藥和利尿劑，1984年確定其化學結構。
summaryZhHans: 布马佐辛是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C20H29NO2，属喷他佐辛的结构类似物，可作为镇痛药和利尿剂，1984年确定其化学结构。

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to study the kappa opioid receptor. It was never marketed as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究 kappa 鴉片受體的實驗室工具，從未作為藥物上市。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究 kappa 鸦片受体的实验室工具，从未作为药物上市。

sideEffects.en: Kappa opioid agonists characteristically cause unpleasant mental effects: feeling detached, dysphoria, confusion and hallucinations, along with sedation and a strong increase in urine production.
sideEffects.zh: kappa 鴉片促效劑典型地造成不適的精神作用：脫離感、情緒惡劣、混亂與幻覺，並伴隨鎮靜與尿量大幅增加。
sideEffects.zhHans: kappa 鸦片促效剂典型地造成不适的精神作用：脱离感、情绪恶劣、混乱与幻觉，并伴随镇静与尿量大幅增加。

fact.en: It is a powerful kappa opioid agonist and a strong diuretic, because kappa receptors in the kidney and pituitary control how much water the body holds on to.
fact.zh: 它是強效的 kappa 鴉片促效劑，同時也是強力的利尿劑，因為腎臟與腦下垂體中的 kappa 受體控制身體保留水分的多寡。
fact.zhHans: 它是强效的 kappa 鸦片促效剂，同时也是强力的利尿剂，因为肾脏与脑下垂体中的 kappa 受体控制身体保留水分的多寡。
